scope: Auto Match terminal-result navigation recovery only; not complete-app acceptance
reported_issue: Match skipped Back and Return Home remain on the result with Navigation is already in progress feedback.
finding: The shared callback-only navigation flag could remain locked indefinitely when the platform router continuation did not settle. Controlled lost-callback cases reproduce this failure class; the exact original simulator trigger is not independently established.
return_ownership: Both terminal-result Back and Return Home retain the source-defined clear-stack return to /pages/home/index. They must not pop to the ended Found result.

implementation.transactions: Each operation owns its Promise, callbacks and watchdog. Identical in-flight intents share one platform call; competing intents remain exclusive. Stale callbacks and timers cannot settle or unlock a newer transaction.
implementation.arrival: Recover missing callbacks only when the real page stack proves the complete destination including entity query, a new page instance and the expected stack depth. Back requires the exact prior target instance. Page mount/show and the next invocation reconcile actual arrival.
implementation.failure: An 8-second watchdog ends a callback-less, unarrived operation as a genuine failure and releases its lock for explicit retry. It does not fake arrival, retry automatically or add an artificial navigation wait.
implementation.cleanup: Clear transaction timers on settlement. Presentation cleanup exceptions cannot strand an already-completed navigation.
implementation.entity_replace: Only genuinely identical normalized path-and-query locations skip replacement; a different match sharing the same page path is not treated as unchanged.
implementation.feedback: Retain the existing branded Toast and use neutral page-opening feedback instead of exposing the internal lock diagnostic. Navigation success still requires a platform outcome or actual arrival evidence.

unchanged: Auto Match state machine and admission/retry charging
existing account, profile, relationships, messages and coin data

coverage: lost callback after actual destination arrival
failed and missing callbacks release for retry
exact entity query and stack validation
same-admission retry does not charge again
navigation leaves exact persisted business bytes unchanged
subsequent Entry and Back remain usable
verification.warnings: No convention or browser warnings. Existing Xcode AppIntents metadata warning and simulator WebKit/Accessibility/process-suspension diagnostics remain in the native log; the focused test passed.
verification.limits: Normal cases run unchanged compiled H5. Lost-callback diagnostic cases wrap the actual router only in isolated test contexts and deliberately leave its returned Promise unsettled after real arrival; wrappers are restored. Browser contexts and native non-persistent data stores do not replace the real host account. This is not complete-app or visual pixel acceptance.
